name: The Strange Hermit
label: Quest
description: The Strange Hermit: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Uh, um... H-hello, I mean to say, hi! Greetings, even! I'm sorry... It's um, been so long since I've actually spoken to another person. I'm afraid I'm a bit rusty at this.
So er, um... How is your day going?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...that's about all I have to say about it. I was--um--somewhere else before I was here. Now I'm here and I have my friends, and my things. T-things I built, I mean. That's about all I need. I think that's all I need, anyway.

I have to say though, it is nice to talk to someone who will talk back. The forest spirits try, but they just end up singing at me. That's nice in its own way, but not exactly s-stimulating conversation.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
